title: Rank-N Lattice Analysis — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Rank-N Lattice Analysis' rich face, its first round, a Sketch and still a proposal: two walks that put the page's two claims to a measurement (the rank of seven measured instruments against chance, and a fit written onto a torus and read back), and the trajectory library's sheet of the struck objects they measure, gathered as it was. I grow when the page is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.

offers.what: "A stiff piano string, a struck bar, a bell needs N ≥ 2: its partials require two or more incommensurate generators" holds as an inequality and misleads as a picture. Measured (the how-many-clocks piece; checks.mjs; 24 loudest partials within 40 dB, 0.19 s after the strike, from the trajectory library; the rank is the clocks plus the partials no clock reaches, at the cheapest naming in bits): the piano's cheapest naming uses one clock, its fundamental (found at 110.52 Hz for A2 though 110 Hz itself is below the floor), and leaves the upper partials alone, rank 13 of 24 for A1 and 15 of 24 for A2 at 5 cents. The rank alone hardly parts A2 from random partials of the same count and levels (their ranks run 14–21), but the bits do: the one clock saves 40.5 and 34.0 bits over naming every partial outright, where twelve random draws save at most 17.1 and 17.8. So the structure is real, and it is one clock and a bend, not two clocks. The rank climbs with what is counted: A2 at 5 cents gives 1, 1, 4, 7, 11, 15 for 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24 partials. Only at 2 cents does a second clock pay for A2, catching a few bent partials. The tuned bars are one clock plus one mode left alone (rank 2 for the vibraphone and the marimba, saving 14.7 and 7.4 bits against chance's 2.2 and 0.0). The bell is rank 18 of 24, and its clocks save 11.3 bits where random partials save up to 15.6 (ranks 15–22): its modes share no clock beyond what random partials share, so it reads like the dense texture of the next bullet. The singing bowl likewise (4.2 bits, chance up to 6.7). A third clock paid in none of 21 measured fits. Suggest the bullet say: a stiff string is one clock and a bend, and its rank read strictly climbs with the partials counted and the tolerance; tuned bars are one clock plus the modes the tuning left; a bell's modes share no clock beyond chance.

"The rank N itself is a measured quantity, a property of the source rather than an assumption imposed on it" needs what it is measured against. Without a price on the integer steps the rank measures nothing: two clocks with steps up to ±16 reach all 12 of 12 random partials within 5 cents (the piece's draw; over 40 seeded draws, 11.3 of 12 on average, all 12 in 15). The piece makes the rank meaningful by pricing the steps (a frequency named outright costs log₂(band ⁄ 2τ) bits, 10.2 at 5 cents; a step count costs its length in a prefix code), and still the rank moves with τ and with the partials counted (offer above). Suggest: "a property of the source at a stated tolerance and partial count, once the integers are priced so that a dense lattice can't fit anything", since the tolerance, the count and the price are chosen, as Fourier's harmonic basis is.

"Rank as an inharmonicity coordinate" needs a second number beside it. Measured at 5 cents with 24 partials, the piano A2 is rank 15 and the bell rank 18: close on the axis, and both inside the ranks random partials reach (14–21, 15–22), yet the piano's clock saves 34.0 bits where chance saves at most 17.8 and the bell's save 11.3 where chance saves 15.6, because the piano's unreached partials are its upper series pushed off one comb by the stretch, and the bell's are modes with no shared clock. Suggest the bullet say the rank is read with its tolerance, its partial count and its margin over chance (in bits saved, which separates them where the rank does not), and that a bent line and a cloud can share a rank. This rests on the rank measurements in the piece; no separate measurement of the bend was made here.

offers.section: The synth as its own oscilloscope
offers.what: "One artifact is simultaneously what was heard … and what will be played back" holds exactly only when the fitted rank is at most two. Measured (the read-both-ways piece; checks.mjs; fit at 5 cents, written onto a 256 × 256 torus, read back by two phasors at 48 kHz): two harmonic partials and the two-clock tone come back whole, every partial at its lattice point, levels within 0.002 and 0.004 dB. A measured piano A2 comes back as 10 of its 24 partials (98.7 % of the energy), each moved onto its lattice point by up to 4.62 cents; the other 14 have no place in a two-dimensional field (the fit's rank is 15). The bell: 8 of 24 (98.5 % of the energy, rank 18). Suggest: the field is what will be played; what was heard is the field plus what no clock reached, the same kind of residual the section's Fourier paragraph names, and each partial plays back on its lattice point, up to τ from where it was heard. The intro's "Analysis and synthesis become two readings of one artifact" is the same claim and could carry the same condition.

verdicts.why: A real test that walks up well, but its A2 rank 15 is a greedy miss (one clock at 110.62 Hz gives rank 13 for fewer bits, saving 40.5) and above about 10 c the step price, not the source, raises the rank (24 perfect harmonics read 11 at 20 c; A2 goes 12 to 15 between 18 and 20 c). Fix: fine-scan the one-clock fit, cap τ at 10 c or say so at the test step, and label the number an upper bound on the cheapest naming.

Honest gathered source figure, tracked; caption only: "filed by rank" means order (k-th mode in slot k) on the one page where rank means generator count, so say "filed by order, not the lattice rank this page means", and name the marimba ×10.52 beside the bars ×1 and ×4.01.

pieces.title: how many clocks · a walk in five steps
pieces.caption: **Does the rank settle at 1, then 2, then more?** One sine; a harmonic tone, where one clock reaches every partial; a tone on two clocks, where two do; random partials, which two clocks also reach once their steps are free, so the fitter prices every step in bits; and last seven measured instruments, each fitted the cheapest way and set beside random partials of the same count. The harmonic tone is rank 1 and the two-clock tone rank 2, as the page says. The piano is one clock and a bend: its rank, 13 to 15 of 24 partials at 5 cents, climbs with what you count, and its clock saves twice the bits chance does. The bell, rank 18, saves no more than random partials. Checked offline on the piece's own engine; the sounds are the measured partials as sines, not the recordings.

pieces.caption: The four struck objects the walk above measures, tracked by the Inharmonic Wavetable Synthesis steward (2026-10-14): each mode filed by rank, the k-th mode in slot k, and drawn as cents off k × f₁, so a harmonic series would lie on the zero line. The labelled ratios mark the loud modes: the bars' sit on whole multiples (×1 and ×4.01), the bowl's at ×1 and ×2 and then ×5.35, ×5.74, ×8.37, the bell's at ×1 and ×1.45.

verdicts.file: Rank-N Lattice Analysis — rich — read both ways.html
verdicts.why: Walks up well, but its law (closes only for rank ≤ 2) fails on its own engine: vibraphone, marimba and the +5 c snap are rank 2 and lose a partial because a one-clock fit leaves θ₂ empty, and free steps place all 24 A2 partials on its 256² torus within 2.13 c (at 259.1 bits vs 245.4 outright), as Three Kinds of Warp.md:95 says. Fix: put the loudest lone partial on θ₂, show the dense reading beside the compressive one, drop "15 dimensions", and say the dB match tests the table, not the claim.

pieces.title: read both ways · a walk in four steps
pieces.caption: **Is the stored field both what was heard and what will be played?** Two partials on one clock, written onto the torus as a one-cycle table and read back whole; a tone on two clocks, which fills the square and comes back whole; one partial pushed sharp, played back in tune while it is within the tolerance and lost past it; and last a measured note, fitted, written onto a 256 × 256 torus and read back, beside what was heard and what was left over. For a sound of rank two or less the round trip closes, to a few thousandths of a dB. For the piano A2 at 5 cents the field carries 10 of 24 partials, 98.7 % of the energy, each moved up to 4.6 cents onto its lattice point; the other 14 have no place in two dimensions. Measured on the read-back itself; nobody has listened to the three side by side.
